description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various model configurations across two datasets, labeled "PHEME" and "PolitiFact," which are visually separated into two panels by a vertical dashed line. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 2.5. The horizontal category axis displays six configurations, with labels rotated slightly downward: "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition." These six categories are grouped together in the same sequence under each of the two dataset headings. Each category is represented by a distinct color: dark red for "Ours," brown for "w/o comments," tan for "w/o text," grey-blue for "w/o select," medium blue for "w/o emotion," and dark blue for "w/o cognition." Every bar is visually emphasized with an annotation of its exact numerical value positioned directly above it. In the PHEME group, the values are 89.84 for "Ours" (the tallest bar in this group), 86.82 for "w/o comments," 80.10 for "w/o text" (the shortest bar in this group), 88.80 for "w/o select," 87.34 for "w/o emotion," and 87.17 for "w/o cognition." In the PolitiFact group, the values are 90.57 for "Ours" (the tallest bar overall), 85.85 for "w/o comments," 83.02 for "w/o text" (the shortest bar in this group), 89.62 for "w/o select," 84.91 for "w/o emotion," and 87.74 for "w/o cognition." The bars are arranged in a consistent categorical order across both groups rather than being sorted by numerical value or alphabetically.
